The script intentionally creates only native Engine project content. UnrealMCP
is used as an editor authoring bridge and is never serialized as a runtime
dependency.

Run from the repository root:

    uv --directory .\Python run python ..\scripts uild_hero_cumulus01_ue.py --stage all

Use the individual stages to resume after a failed compile without recreating
assets that were already saved successfully.
